future_single_hook.following: After producer restart or following an existing request, original submit and elapsed stay null. A new follow-start describes only a partial observation window. Never backfill from mtime/index/UTC.
future_single_hook.error: Preserve elapsed-to-error with the original exception/unknown result. Timing errors are nonfatal and never replay actions; killed-before-retention remains missing.

future_single_hook.limit: This single lifecycle records inclusive FULL wall. Disk latency and scheduler/queue delay remain combined unless existing phase evidence separates them.

accounting.FULL: Same-producer (receipt_validated_ns-submit_ns)/1e9. Include zero-day AUTO, MET/SEM/SAVE and failed waits.
accounting.outer: FULL wall minus union of all child RPC intervals is combined outer/unobserved wall, including JSON/disk/ACK/guards/dispatch/feeder. Do not call it all CPU, Native or disk.
accounting.Queue: With complete probe coverage, call_total minus contained RPC intervals gives pre/post Queue wall. Separate existing phases without parent/child double counting. Generated prefix and FULL/feeder tail remain separate or unknown.
accounting.clock: Join by existing sequence/control identity. Monotonic absolute values are used only within proven same clock/producer lifetime; never invent SDK perf_counter origins or bridge a restart.
accounting.days: Use existing verified before/after date_raw from prior closed result/owned FULL state and this result, /24. Missing before or rollback scope means unknown; no extra MET.
accounting.zero_unknown: Keep all zero-day/failed wall. Zero days => s/day null. Partial/unknown days need existing paired verified evidence, never ACK.
accounting.campaign: Keep AUTO9 2026-10-19T03:26:49.420926Z and all maintenance, SAVE, failure and restart gaps. Local windows supplement it; concurrent builds or repair pauses are not subtracted.
